description: Per-test-case record schema for the Carto plugin test framework. Every test case emitted by the ArcMap (Py2.7) and ArcGIS Pro (Py3) harnesses conforms to this schema. Written to reports/ALL_TEST_RESULTS.json and reports/ALL_TEST_RESULTS.csv.

status_semantics.PASS: Tool ran and all assertions for the test case were satisfied.
status_semantics.FAIL: Tool ran but one or more assertions failed, OR the tool crashed unexpectedly.
status_semantics.WARN: Tool ran and produced output, but a soft check (non-blocking) was not satisfied (e.g. no measurable change where some was expected, or an optional metric out of preferred band).
status_semantics.SKIP: Pre-conditions not met (missing layer/parameter, environment not capable, e.g. Plugin07 needs an active map document). skip_reason explains why.
